pull_request.title: Infrastructure: simplify token chart to numbered work steps
pull_request.head: codex/token-step-numbers
pull_request.body:
The token chart's dedicated milestone lines and PR/date labels (#3, #14, #28, etc.) clutter the numbered usage steps. Remove those annotations in all three counter modes and keep the step numbers, hover/focus details and links to the recorded work.

The chart uses the space previously reserved for milestone labels. Its date range follows observed usage and build time. Remove obsolete annotation styles, source-list markup and milestone copy. The historical catalogue remains validated in the JSON export; token observations and the other Pages tabs are preserved.

Validation: all 28 token-site Python tests, both existing Node suites, token/session validation, the complete Pages build, real-output SVG inspection, software inventory checks and whitespace checks passed. The updated regression confirms milestone metadata cannot annotate or resize any chart mode while numbered links remain. No browser-rendering pass was available.

Infrastructure only; no scientific progress or sign-off changes.
